title: cine3d demo: real 3D phone + transistor (engine test, no voice)
_note: Hand-made test for the cine3d kit (26 Nov 2026): fake word timings in vo_words.json, silent vo.mp3. The phone is Apple's own AR model (public/models, never in git).

scenes.text: The real iPhone eighteen Pro, with a live feed on its screen.
scenes.visual: Real 3D phone, 3/4 front, slow orbit, scrolling feed mapped on the display.

scenes.text: Turn it around: the back, and the camera plateau.
scenes.visual: The phone turns from its edge to a 3/4 back hero.

scenes.text: Push in on the lenses, with real depth of field.
scenes.visual: Macro on the plateau and lenses.

scenes.text: The back turns to glass: the A twenty Pro sits here.
scenes.visual: X-ray: ghost glass back, code-drawn logic board aligned inside, callout via anchors.

scenes.text: Lift the back away and move in on the board.
scenes.visual: Back glass lifts off, camera pushes in on the board.

scenes.text: Inside that chip: one nanosheet transistor.
The gate switches on, and electrons stream through every sheet.
scenes.visual: Gate on/off, channels glow, electrons stream.

scenes.text: Pull back: billions of them, side by side.
scenes.visual: Pull-back over a field of transistors.

scenes.text: The same transistor, through a lens over the package.
scenes.visual: Lite inset in a round lens over the 2D A20 Pro package.

scenes.text: Cut it open: every layer of the gate, wrapped round each sheet.
scenes.visual: Deep cut-away of the transistor, low three-quarter macro.
